messages:
maria: opened a tiny PR to add a short operational playbook for handling service-side context trims. goal: actionable snippet + repro steps so eng teams can test locally.

sam: can you paste the minimal node + curl snippets here? i'll run them through snippet-lint.

maria: node example (really tiny):
```javascript
// detect-and-shorten (concept)
const res = await fetch(RW_URL, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
if (res.status === 429) await rw.retry_helper.backoff();
if (res.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim')) {
  payload.system = shortenForTrim(payload.system);
  await fetch(RW_URL, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
}
```

maria: curl repro (points at staging trim-sim):
```bash
curl -i -X POST "$TRIM_SIM_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @large_prompt.json
# expect header: x-rw-context-trim: true
```

kevin: i'll add the python requests snippet and a small pytest that mocks headers. plan to put tests in a follow-up PR so this stays reviewable.

liz: editorial: add a one-line decision note: detect-and-shorten is best when you want to preserve full prompts most of the time; prefer proactive truncation for strict latency budgets. also add links: errref for 429/timeouts + SDK retry-policy guide.

sam: lint catch: fenced languages should be "javascript" and "bash" (not generic). ci-bot will run snippet-lint on PR.

docs-bot: PR #995 opened by maria  reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed for PR #995: fence lang mismatch on one block; trailing whitespace in example.

maria: fixing the fence tags and trimming whitespace, adding the small decision blurb and links. pushing a fix now.

kevin: once green i'll follow up with the pytest + fixture that returns headers={'x-rw-context-trim': 'true'}. i'll reference the staging harness in the test.

sam: i'll re-run snippet-lint and then do a content pass. small nit: call the pattern consistently "detect-and-shorten" (hyphenated) in the header and cross-links.

liz: copyedit note: use second-person imperative in the short checklist (Detect -> Shorten -> Retry -> Fallback). also add a 'When not to use' one-liner.

maria: updated to use "detect-and-shorten" and added the short checklist + when-not-to-use line. thanks team, tagging @liz for final pass on green.

ci-bot: snippet-lint passed for PR #995  all checks green.

sam: quick approve from me after green. merging once liz signs off.

liz: copyedit done. looks good. merging. i'll follow up with a short social blurb for the docs release notes.

maria: merged, thanks everyone :rocket:
